title: Old King Clancy
cn: 第 18 集 · 老国王克兰西
novel:
Marshall and Barney [[told|tell]] an [[elaborate|elaborate]] lie to their boss at GNB. They needed to [[conceal|conceal]] a [[complicated|complicate]] truth, so they [[wove|weave]] a story about Canada, a [[celebrity|celebrity]], and a [[bizarre|bizarre]] [[encounter|encounter]].

The truth was this: Robin had once tried to [[seduce|seduce]] a Canadian celebrity. The attempt [[failed|fail]] [[spectacularly|spectacular]], and the celebrity [[rejected|reject]] her with a strange phrase. Robin was [[mortified|mortify]].

"You can't tell anyone," Robin [[begged|beg]].

But Barney could not [[resist|resist]]. He turned Robin's story into an [[epic|epic]] tale, adding [[absurd|absurd]] [[details|detail]] at every turn. The boss was [[entertained|entertain]] but [[suspicious|suspicious]].

"Is any of this true?" the boss asked.

Marshall [[panicked|panic]]. "All of it," he said with a forced smile.

The lie grew bigger and bigger. Barney [[invented|invent]] a fake Canadian tradition called "Old King Clancy." He [[claimed|claim]] it was a famous [[ritual|ritual]] involving hockey and maple syrup.

Robin was [[furious|furious]]. "You're making me look [[ridiculous|ridiculous]]!" she [[whispered|whisper]].

Finally, the boss [[discovered|discover]] the truth. He was not angry — he was [[amused|amuse]]. "You guys are [[entertaining|entertain]]," he said. "But next time, just tell the truth."

Marshall and Barney [[agreed|agree]]. The truth, they [[learned|learn]], was always simpler.

weave.en: to create a story by combining details

seduce.en: to attract someone into a relationship

spectacular.en: in a very impressive or dramatic way

mortify.en: to make someone feel extremely embarrassed

beg.en: to ask someone desperately for something

resist.en: to stop yourself from doing something

entertain.en: to keep someone interested and amused

suspicious.en: feeling that something is not right

invent.en: to make up something that is not real

ritual.en: something done in a fixed way
